```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})
opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.align='center', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)

# ---- read meta (from anagine report.js) ----
meta <- tryCatch(jsonlite::fromJSON(params$meta_json, flatten = TRUE), error = function(e) list())
requested_by <- if (!is.null(meta$requested_by)) as.character(meta$requested_by)[1] else ""
if (length(requested_by) == 0 || is.na(requested_by) || requested_by == "") requested_by <- ""

escape_latex_text <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x) || x == "") return("")
  x <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", x)
  x <- gsub("([#$%&_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

generated_at <- if (!is.null(meta$generated_at)) as.character(meta$generated_at) else ""
if (length(generated_at) == 0 || is.na(generated_at[1]) || generated_at[1] == "") {
  gt <- Sys.time()
} else {
  ga <- generated_at[1]
  ga <- sub("Z$", "+0000", ga)
  ga <- sub("([+-][0-9]{2}):([0-9]{2})$", "\\1\\2", ga)
  gt <- as.POSIXct(ga, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%OS%z", tz = "UTC")
  if (is.na(gt)) gt <- Sys.time()
}

report_month <- format(gt, "%B, %Y")
report_date  <- format(gt, "%B %d, %Y")
gt_et <- as.POSIXct(format(gt, tz = "America/New_York", usetz = TRUE), tz = "America/New_York")
report_time  <- format(gt_et, "%I:%M %p %Z")

# fetchedData -> data.frame
df <- meta$fetchedData
if (is.null(df)) df <- data.frame()
if (is.list(df) && !is.data.frame(df)) df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df)

pick_col <- function(df, candidates) {
  nm <- names(df)
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nm]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
}

# primary_site: primary_site, primary_site_of_disease, diagnoses.primary_site
ps_col <- pick_col(df, c("primary_site", "primary_site_of_disease", "PrimarySite", "diagnoses.primary_site"))
if (!is.na(ps_col)) {
  ps_raw <- df[[ps_col]]
  df$primary_site_val <- vapply(ps_raw, function(v) {
    if (is.null(v)) return(NA_character_)
    if (is.list(v) || (is.vector(v) && length(v) > 1)) {
      v <- unlist(v)
      v <- v[!is.na(v) & trimws(as.character(v)) != ""]
      if (length(v) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      return(as.character(v[1]))
    }
    as.character(v)
  }, character(1))
} else {
  df$primary_site_val <- NA_character_
}
df$primary_site_val[is.na(df$primary_site_val) | trimws(df$primary_site_val) == ""] <- "Unknown"

# sex/gender: sex, gender, demographics.gender, demographics.sex
sex_col <- pick_col(df, c("sex", "gender", "demographics.gender", "demographics.sex"))
if (!is.na(sex_col)) {
  sex_raw <- df[[sex_col]]
  df$sex_val <- vapply(sex_raw, function(v) {
    if (is.null(v)) return(NA_character_)
    if (is.list(v)) {
      if (!is.null(v$gender)) return(as.character(v$gender))
      if (!is.null(v$sex)) return(as.character(v$sex))
      v <- unlist(v)
      v <- v[!is.na(v) & trimws(as.character(v)) != ""]
      if (length(v) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      return(as.character(v[1]))
    }
    if (is.vector(v) && length(v) > 1) {
      v <- v[!is.na(v) & trimws(as.character(v)) != ""]
      if (length(v) == 0) return(NA_character_)
      return(as.character(v[1]))
    }
    as.character(v)
  }, character(1))
} else {
  df$sex_val <- NA_character_
}
df$sex_val[is.na(df$sex_val) | trimws(df$sex_val) == ""] <- "Unknown"
```

```{r cover_pdf, results='asis'}
}
```

```{r cover_html, results='asis'}
if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat("# Test Report - Primary Site and Sex\n\n")
  if (file.exists("AlcHepNet_logo.jpg")) {
    cat("<div style='text-align:center;'>\n")
    cat("<img src='AlcHepNet_logo.jpg' style='width:52%; max-width:520px;' />\n")
    cat("</div>\n\n")
  }
  if (nzchar(requested_by)) {
    cat(sprintf("Report generated for `%s`\n\n", requested_by))
  }
  cat(sprintf("**%s**  \n", report_month))
  cat(sprintf("Data extracted %s at %s\n\n", report_date, report_time))
}
```

```{r summary_stats, results='asis'}
N <- nrow(df)
n_proj <- length(unique(df$project_id[!is.na(df$project_id)]))
cat(sprintf("**Participants:** %d  \n**Projects:** %d\n\n", N, n_proj))
```

## Primary Site
```{r primary_site_table, results='asis'}
if (nrow(df) == 0 || all(df$primary_site_val == "Unknown")) {
  cat("No primary_site data. Please include primary_site in fetch fields.\n")
} else {
  tab <- df %>% count(primary_site_val, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  colnames(tab) <- c("Primary Site", "Count", "Percent (%)")
  print(knitr::kable(tab))
}
```

```{r primary_site_plot, fig.cap="Primary Site distribution", fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(df) > 0 && !all(df$primary_site_val == "Unknown")) {
  tab <- df %>% count(primary_site_val, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    head(20)
  tab$primary_site_val <- factor(tab$primary_site_val, levels = rev(tab$primary_site_val))
  ggplot(tab, aes(x = primary_site_val, y = percent, fill = primary_site_val)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s (%.2f%%)", n, percent)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Primary Site", x = "", y = "Percent (%)") +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9))
}
```

## Sex
```{r sex_table, results='asis'}
if (nrow(df) == 0 || all(df$sex_val == "Unknown")) {
  cat("No Sex data. Please include gender or sex in fetch fields.\n")
} else {
  tab <- df %>% count(sex_val, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  colnames(tab) <- c("Sex", "Count", "Percent (%)")
  print(knitr::kable(tab))
}
```

```{r sex_plot, fig.cap="Sex distribution", fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(df) > 0 && !all(df$sex_val == "Unknown")) {
  tab <- df %>% count(sex_val, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))
  tab <- tab %>% mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%d, %.1f%%)", sex_val, n, percent))
  ggplot(tab, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = sex_val)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4) +
    labs(title = "Sex", fill = "Sex") +
    theme_void()
}
```
